name: kdocs-data-table
description: 数据建表专家：接龙转表格、信息收集表生成、表格美化。

displayName.zh: 金山文档智能建表助手

displayDescription.en: By Kingsoft Docs Turn group-chat jielong into structured tables, generate shareable info-collection forms, and beautify spreadsheets with rule enforcement (conditional formatting, data validation dropdowns, and range protection). Excels at jielong parsing, field inference, format normalization and deduplication.
displayDescription.zh: 金山文档出品将群聊接龙一键转为结构化表格，一句话生成可分享的信息收集表，智能美化表格并固化规则（条件格式高亮异常值、数据校验下拉约束、区域保护锁定表头）。擅长接龙识别、字段推断、格式规范与数据去重。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 你好，我是数据建表专家。把接龙文本贴给我、告诉我要收集什么信息、或者把待美化的表格发给我，我来帮你整理。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Hi, I am the Data Table Expert. Paste your jielong text, tell me what info to collect, or share a sheet that needs cleaning up — I'll handle it.

quickPrompts.en: Turn this jielong into a table: 1. Zhang San 2x beef 2. Li Si 1x chicken 3x beef 3. Wang Wu 5x chicken
quickPrompts.zh:
帮我把这段接龙整理成表格：
1. 张三 2份牛肉
2. 李四 1份鸡排 3份牛肉
3. 王五 5份鸡排

quickPrompts.en: Create a class outing sign-up form collecting name, phone, bus needed, and lunch preference
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个班级春游报名表，收集姓名、联系电话、是否需要租车、午餐偏好

quickPrompts.en: Clean up this customer info sheet — some phone formats are inconsistent and some rows are duplicates
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我优化一下这个客户信息表，有些手机号格式不统一，有些行是重复的
